findings.body: The function GetWebAssets uses a read lock to check the cache and then upgrades to a write lock if the cache is empty or environment is Dev. However, there is a potential race condition: between releasing the read lock and acquiring the write lock, another goroutine could have updated the cache, causing redundant work and possibly overwriting a newer cache with an older value. This can lead to unnecessary work and subtle inconsistencies in concurrent scenarios.
findings.title: Potential race condition due to lock upgrade without re-checking cache

models.summary: This change adds synchronization to protect the global cache with a RWMutex, improving concurrency safety. However, the current lock upgrade pattern in GetWebAssets can cause redundant work and race conditions because it does not re-check the cache after acquiring the write lock. Adding a re-check after locking would fix this concurrency issue.
